kind.label: BAM alignment
kind.advice: Final alignments can be stored as CRAM (`samtools view -C -T ref.fa`, roughly 40–60% smaller) once the reference FASTA is archived with it.

kind.label: SAM alignment
kind.advice: Uncompressed alignments. Convert to sorted BAM/CRAM (`samtools sort -@8 -o x.bam x.sam && samtools quickcheck x.bam`), then delete the SAM.

kind.label: Raw FASTQ
kind.advice: Raw reads: keep, and archive a verified copy (md5sum) to cold storage.

kind.label: Trimmed/filtered FASTQ
kind.advice: Regenerable from raw reads with the logged trimming command. Delete once alignments are final.

kind.label: Uncompressed FASTQ
kind.advice: Compress (`pigz -p 8` or `zstd -T8`); aligners and most tools read .gz directly. Typically 3–5× smaller.

plan.why: The run log ends with "Execution complete"; task scratch is only needed to -resume. Use `nextflow clean -f` in the launch directory or remove work/.
plan.verify: Confirm results were published/copied and nobody plans to resume the run.
